name: Naomi
source:
"I won't give in! I won't let you break me!"

She joins the nunnery on impulse after getting dumped by her boyfriend. She planned on leaving after six months.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4118730/The_Sinful_Nuns_Undelivered_Prayers/]Steam[/url]]
